framings.label: Live results and vote tracking
framings.description: Posts present the midterms as a running tally of races, maps and charts, reporting who won or leads without much interpretation.

framings.label: Democratic mandate and governing agenda
framings.description: Posts treat the Democratic win of Congress and state legislatures as a mandate and look at what the party will do with power, such as tariff reversal, Supreme Court reform, election law changes, AI limits and leadership choices.

framings.label: Republican and Trump fallout
framings.description: Posts focus on the Republican defeat as a rebuke of Trump and a source of turmoil, covering aides doubting his focus, White House staff changes, 2028 worries and the Iran war.

framings.label: Markets, business and economy
framings.description: Posts view the results through their financial effects, including falling stocks, AI-sector jitters, business implications and policy forecasts.

framings.label: Voter blocs and long-term political shifts
framings.description: Posts interpret the results as evidence of wider trends, such as women voters, progressive versus moderate Democrats, populism, historical comparisons and the 2028 outlook.
